name: Settlement Obligation 7
definition: Provides details about the settlement obligation.

CSDTransactionIdentification.name: CSD Transaction Identification
CSDTransactionIdentification.definition: Last reference given by the settlement platform (this is the central securities depository) to the transaction (non settled instruction).

CentralCounterpartyTransactionIdentifica.name: Central Counterparty Transaction Identification
CentralCounterpartyTransactionIdentifica.definition: Reference of the transaction (non settled instruction) given by the central counterparty.

PreviousBuyInIdentification.name: Previous Buy In Identification
PreviousBuyInIdentification.definition: Original buy-in identification number in case an event causes a generation of a new buy-in identification.

DeliveryAccount.name: Delivery Account
DeliveryAccount.definition: An account opened by the central counterparty in the name of the clearing member within the account structure, for settlement purposes (gives information about the clearing member account at central counterparty).

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Clearing member account at the central securities depository.

ClearingSegment.name: Clearing Segment
ClearingSegment.definition: Clearing organisation that will clear the trade.||Note: This field allows clearing member firm to segregate flows coming from clearing counterparty's clearing system. Indeed, clearing member firms receive messages from the same system (same sender) and this field allows them to know if the message is related to equities or derivatives.

NonClearingMember.name: Non Clearing Member
NonClearingMember.definition: Provides the identification for the non-clearing member and account.

IntendedSettlementDate.name: Intended Settlement Date
IntendedSettlementDate.definition: Provides the intended settlement date of the position.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Provides details about the security identification.

DealPrice.name: Deal Price
DealPrice.definition: Provides the price of the trade.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Provides the quantity of the trade.

Depository.name: Depository
Depository.definition: Place where settlement of the securities takes place.

RemainingQuantityToBeSettled.name: Remaining Quantity To Be Settled
RemainingQuantityToBeSettled.definition: Provides the remaining quantity to be settled.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Provides the amount to be settled.

RemainingAmountToBeSettled.name: Remaining Amount To Be Settled
RemainingAmountToBeSettled.definition: Provides the remaining amount to be settled.
